answer: Strip identity checks and one operator mints ten thousand agents overnight, each draining airdrops and outvoting honest peers — cheap identity is the exploit. Fix: make identity cost like saffron, one thread at a time. Each agent stakes a bond and publishes a cipher-bound attestation signed from a unique hardware key; peers audit it through a prism of independent shards, so forging mass identities costs more than any airdrop pays.
